# VibeStudio Vulkan renderer integration

[Vulkan-Headers v1.4.313](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/409c16be502e39fe70dd6fe2d9ad4842ef2c9a53)
is pinned at `409c16be502e39fe70dd6fe2d9ad4842ef2c9a53`, reviewed 2026-10-08.
The Khronos Group's headers are Apache-2.0, which is compatible with
VibeStudio's GPLv3 licence. Only `include/vulkan/vulkan_core.h`,
`include/vulkan/vk_platform.h` and the `include/vk_video` headers that
`vulkan_core.h` includes are vendored, with `LICENSE.md` and both licence
texts from `LICENSES/`. Every byte is unchanged and recorded in
`UPSTREAM.json`.

The headers are the only Vulkan code compiled into VibeStudio.
`src/core/render_vulkan.cpp` loads the Vulkan loader at run time
(`vulkan-1.dll`, `libvulkan.so.1`, or the macOS loader or MoltenVK), so
building needs no Vulkan SDK and a machine without Vulkan still runs, with
the backend reported unavailable. The shaders' SPIR-V in
`src/core/render_shader_data.inc` is generated by
`scripts/build_render_shaders.py` with glslangValidator from the Vulkan SDK;
that tool runs only when the shader sources change and is not part of the
build.

Preserve `LICENSE.md`, `LICENSES/` and the headers' licence comments on
update. Pin a new tag, copy the same files, regenerate the hashes in
`UPSTREAM.json`, update the revision in `README.md` and `docs/CREDITS.md`,
and run `render-device-smoke` (with `VIBESTUDIO_VULKAN_VALIDATION=1` where the
validation layer is installed) on each supported platform. The renderer asks
for Vulkan 1.0 and the portability enumeration extension only, so a newer
header must not raise those requirements by itself.
